text.p: PictureTel Corp said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire MultiLink Inc in a deal valued at about $40 million.
PictureTel said it expects the transaction to be dilutive to earnings in 1997 because of one-time expenses but predicts the acquisition will enhance PictureTel's results in 1998.

The company said each share of MultiLink common stock will be swapped for 0.56 a share of PictureTel common stock. Also, outstanding options to purchase MultiLink stock will be converted at this exchange ratio into PictureTel options.
MultiLink shareholders will own about 10 percent of the combined company's shares while PictureTel shareholders will own the rest.
The $40 million value is based on the closing price of PictureTel stock on April 15.
MultiLink, based in Andover, Mass., supplies multipoint audioconferencing systems. The transaction is expected to close in PictureTel's second quarter, the company said.
